name: Leng Ghoul

generalAbilities.name: Erudite
generalAbilities.description: Leng ghouls can cast arcane, divine, and occult spells from scrolls, with a spell DC of 28 and a spell attack roll of +20.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. vitality

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Absorb Memories
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The Leng ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that retains flesh on its bones

Effect The Leng ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 6d6 Healing Damage Hit Points. At the same time, they also absorb some of the memories stored in the flesh from when the corpse was alive, gaining a +1 status bonus to all skill checks for 10 minutes.

The Leng ghoul can immediately attempt an Occultism check to learn one non-secret memory the corpse had when it was alive (use the standard DC for the creature's level). The exact memory learned is determined by the GM but is typically something of use to the Leng ghoul. The memory can't be one the creature was trying to keep secret unless the check was a critical success.

A Leng ghoul can Absorb Memories from any given corpse only once.

Effect: Absorb Memories

offensiveAbilities.name: Leng Ghoul Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 4d8 Void Damage damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 4d8 Void Damage damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Leng ghoul the next sunset.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: Any living creature hit by a Leng ghoul's attack must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: A Leng ghoul deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.
